title: 风琴管着火了怎么办（国内版）
source_doc: course/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/02_Burning Laser Bellows Jan2020.md
author_source: project/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/02_Burning Laser Bellows Jan2020（国内版）/src.py

points.K4: 积灰既是隐患也是燃料

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台激光切割机旁，手里拿着灭火器模型
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an industrial laser cutting machine, holding a small model fire extinguisher.
shots.narration: 这一课讲激光切割机里的一场小火。

shots.scene: 风琴管、火苗、急停按钮、灭火器、电话五个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a ribbed bellows tube, a small flame, a red emergency stop button, a fire extinguisher, and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 认识风琴管，看懂火情，学会处置。

shots.scene: 阿杰在切割机旁玩手机，机器在切割
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at a blank phone screen while a laser cutting machine runs behind him.
shots.narration: 阿杰开着切割机，低头看手机。

shots.scene: 机头上方的波纹护套里透出一点红光，冒出细烟
shots.prompt_en: A small red glow and a thin wisp of smoke appear between the folds of a ribbed bellows tube above the cutting head inside the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 机头上方的护套里，悄悄冒出红光。

shots.scene: 小研闻到焦味，指着机器喊阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sniffs a burning smell and points urgently at the machine, calling to the young male student.
shots.narration: 小研闻到焦味，赶紧提醒他。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前，表情严肃
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard with a serious expression.
shots.narration: 这一点红光，到底是怎么回事？

shots.scene: 示意图：切割头上方一根可伸缩的波纹管包着光路
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram: a vertical ribbed bellows tube wraps the beam path above a laser cutting head. No people.
shots.narration: 切割头上方这根波纹管，叫风琴管。

shots.scene: 切割头上下移动，风琴管随之伸长缩短
shots.prompt_en: Animation: the cutting head moves up and down and the bellows tube stretches and compresses with it. No people.
shots.narration: 它随机头伸缩，护着里面的光路。

shots.scene: 风琴管外灰尘飞舞，管内的光路干干净净
shots.prompt_en: Dust floats outside the bellows tube while the beam path inside stays clean. No people.
shots.narration: 挡住粉尘，让光束干净地通过。

shots.scene: 风琴管侧面褶皱上一个烧开的小洞，洞里橙红色火光
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a burned hole in the side folds of a black bellows tube with an orange-red glow inside. No people.
shots.narration: 可这根护套，也会被烧穿。

shots.scene: 火光在褶皱间忽明忽暗，洞口边缘发黑
shots.prompt_en: The glow flickers between the folds, and the edges of the hole are charred black. No people.
shots.narration: 洞口发黑，里面还在阴燃。

shots.scene: 镜头拉远：风琴管下面是切割头和一束气管、电缆
shots.prompt_en: Wider view: below the bellows tube are the cutting head and a bundle of gas hoses and cables tied together. No people.
shots.narration: 着火点下面，就是气管和电缆。

shots.scene: 火苗沿着管线蔓延的示意图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a flame spreading along hoses and cables to a cutting head, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 火一大，整个机头都会被烧坏。

shots.section_title: 积灰既是隐患也是燃料
shots.scene: 风琴管旁的导轨和机架上积满黑色烟灰
shots.prompt_en: Thick black soot and debris coat the guide rail and frame next to the bellows tube. No people.
shots.narration: 看旁边，机架上积满了黑灰。
overlay: 积灰既是隐患也是燃料

shots.section_title: 积灰既是隐患也是燃料
shots.scene: 积灰图标加上火苗图标，箭头指向更大的火
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a dust pile plus a small flame, with an arrow pointing to a larger fire. No people.
shots.narration: 积灰和碎屑，正好给火添了燃料。

shots.scene: 远景中风琴管上部仍有一个暗红色的点
shots.prompt_en: A wider view of the machine head where a dull red spot is still visible on the upper bellows tube. No people.
shots.narration: 镜头拉远，红点还在。

shots.scene: 欣欣摇头，身旁一个沙漏和仍在发红的小火点
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head beside an hourglass and a small glowing ember icon.
shots.narration: 阴燃不会自己灭，越拖越危险。

shots.scene: 示意图：光束偏离中心，打在风琴管内壁上
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a light beam drifts off center inside the bellows tube and hits its inner wall. No people.
shots.narration: 光路偏了，光束就会打到护套上。

shots.scene: 风琴管一节塌陷下垂，伸进光路
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: one section of the bellows tube sags inward into the beam path. No people.
shots.narration: 护套变形塌进光路，也会被点着。

shots.scene: 脏污的镜片图标旁冒出热浪
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a dirty lens with heat waves rising from it. No people.
shots.narration: 镜片脏了、积灰多了，都容易起火。

shots.scene: 老李拿着手电检查风琴管
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects the bellows tube with a flashlight while the machine is switched off.
shots.narration: 具体原因，请维修人员来查。

shots.scene: 阿杰按下切割机上的红色急停按钮
shots.prompt_en: The young male student presses the large red emergency stop button on the laser cutting machine.
shots.narration: 发现冒烟或红光，先停激光。

shots.scene: 急停后，激光图标熄灭，机头停止
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: after the emergency stop, the laser icon turns off and the cutting head stops moving. No people.
shots.narration: 按急停，切断光束和运动。

shots.scene: 举着手机拍火的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person filming a small fire with a phone, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 先处置，不要先拍视频。

shots.scene: 小研从墙上取下二氧化碳灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes a carbon dioxide fire extinguisher from its wall bracket.
shots.narration: 初起小火，用就近合适的灭火器。

shots.scene: 水桶泼向带电机器的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bucket of water thrown at an electrical machine, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 带电设备着火，不能用水泼。

shots.scene: 小研站在侧面，背后是畅通的出口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands to the side of the machine with a clear exit path behind her.
shots.narration: 站在出口一侧，没把握就别硬扑。

shots.scene: 机器冒出浓烟，火苗变大
shots.prompt_en: Thick smoke pours from the machine as the flames grow larger. No people.
shots.narration: 火势变大，马上放弃扑救。

shots.scene: 阿杰拨打电话，屏幕上是数字119
shots.prompt_en: The young male student dials on a phone while running toward the exit; a large icon shows the numbers 119.
shots.narration: 按下报警按钮，拨打119。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰沿疏散指示走出车间，关上门
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student follow an emergency exit sign out of the workshop and close the door.
shots.narration: 沿疏散通道撤离，随手关门。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员接听电话，老周赶来
shots.prompt_en: The security officer answers a phone call while the older man hurries over.
shots.narration: 同时报告老师、学院和保卫处。

shots.scene: 切割中无人在场的机器图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a running laser cutting machine with nobody around it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 切割过程中，人不能离开。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在机旁，盯着观察窗，手机收进口袋
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands beside the machine watching through the closed viewing window, his phone put away.
shots.narration: 眼睛盯着机器，发现异常马上停。

shots.scene: 老李关闭总电源，挂上锁和空白警示牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off the main power and attaches a padlock and a blank warning tag to the switch.
shots.narration: 起火后停机，断电上锁挂牌。

shots.scene: 老李戴手套，取下烧坏的风琴管
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, wearing gloves, removes a damaged bellows tube from the machine.
shots.narration: 换护套、校光路，交给授权维修人员。

shots.scene: 学生自己拆机头的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a student opening up a laser cutting head with tools, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 学生不要自己拆机修理。

shots.scene: 老李手持空白检查表，逐项查看风琴管和导轨
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds a blank checklist and inspects the bellows tube and guide rails item by item.
shots.narration: 日常检查风琴管，有破损就停用。

shots.scene: 小研用吸尘器清理机架上的积灰
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student cleans dust from the machine frame with a vacuum cleaner while the machine is off.
shots.narration: 定期清理积灰，不给火留燃料。

shots.scene: 老周和王老师在空白记录本上填写事故记录
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the safety administrator fill in a blank incident record book together.
shots.narration: 小火也要如实报告、记录原因。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现急停、灭火器、119、锁、检查表五个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside five icons: an emergency stop button, a fire extinguisher, a phone with 119, a padlock, and a checklist.
shots.narration: 先停激光，小火扑救，大火报警。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在机旁认真看着观察窗
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands beside the closed machine, attentively watching through the viewing window.
shots.narration: 有人看管、断电检修、勤查勤扫。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研、老李在切割机旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the young male student, the female graduate student and the facility engineer beside the laser cutting machine.
shots.narration: 小火早发现，大事不发生。
